patch_description: Replace the current 26-parameter, 4-group design (score 0.66) with the proven single-shared-parameter "theta" tri-axis design (RX→RY→dense CZ ring+antipodal→RZ) that previously scored 0.80 with only 8 parameters, and then duplicate that entire block once more (reusing the same "theta" parameter) right after the first block's final RZ layer. This follows the recommendation that stacking a second shared-θ block with dense CZ connectivity can roughly halve convergence steps while keeping the parameter count fixed at 8, since all gates in both blocks reuse the identical single trainable parameter. This should improve parameter economy (back to 8 params) and speed convergence relative to the 26-param variant, while preserving the perfect train/val/test accuracy already observed.
